nodes.description: Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply storage variable initialized in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of allowances, written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor that sets name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and assigns the whole supply to msg.sender.
Public view returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked arithmetic.
Public view returning the balance of tokenOwner.
Public view returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using balances and allowed[from][msg.sender].
SafeMath addition a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction a - b with require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division a / b with require(b > 0).
Caller address used as supply recipient, balance owner, allowance owner and transfer source.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply, potential arithmetic underflow.
Addition c = a + b in safeAdd (integer overflow candidate guarded by require).
Subtraction c = a - b in safeSub (integer underflow candidate guarded by require).
Multiplication c = a * b in safeMul (integer overflow candidate guarded by require).
Division c = a / b in safeDiv with require(b > 0).
Address parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Address parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Address parameter spender of allowance.
Address parameter spender of approve.
uint parameter tokens of approve used as allowance amount.
Address parameter to of transfer, the recipient.
uint parameter tokens of transfer, the amount moved.
Address parameter from of transferFrom, the debited account.
Address parameter to of transferFrom, the credited account.
uint parameter tokens of transferFrom, the amount moved.
uint parameter a of safeAdd.
uint parameter b of safeAdd.
uint parameter a of safeSub.
uint parameter b of safeSub.
uint parameter a of safeMul.
uint parameter b of safeMul.
uint parameter a of safeDiv.
uint parameter b of safeDiv.
Local return variable c holding the result of a + b in safeAdd.
Local return variable c holding the result of a - b in safeSub.
Local return variable c holding the result of a * b in safeMul.
Local return variable c holding the result of a / b in safeDiv.
Named return variable balance of balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining of allowance.
Named return variable success of approve.
Named return variable success of transfer.
Named return variable success of transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire initial supply inside the constructor.
Constructor writes _totalSupply.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender].
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
balanceOf uses the tokenOwner parameter as mapping key.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns the named return variable balance.
allowance uses tokenOwner as first mapping key.
allowance uses spender as second mapping key.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
allowance returns the named return variable remaining.
approve uses spender as allowance key.
approve uses tokens as the allowance amount.
approve authorizes msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve returns the named return variable success.
transfer uses the to parameter as credit recipient.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as the amount.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] without authorization checks.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer writes the balances mapping.
transfer returns the named return variable success.
transferFrom uses the from parameter as debit account.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as credit recipient.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as the amount.
transferFrom relies on msg.sender for the allowance lookup allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances and allowance updates.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom returns the named return variable success.
safeAdd consumes parameter a.
safeAdd consumes parameter b.
safeAdd executes the addition a + b.
Local c is the result of the addition in safeAdd.
safeSub consumes parameter a.
safeSub consumes parameter b.
safeSub executes the subtraction a - b.
Local c is the result of the subtraction in safeSub.
safeMul consumes parameter a.
safeMul consumes parameter b.
safeMul executes the multiplication a * b.
Local c is the result of the multiplication in safeMul.
safeDiv consumes parameter a.
safeDiv consumes parameter b.
safeDiv executes the division a / b.
Local c is the result of the division in safeDiv.

Parameter of transferFrom; it selects the credited balance entry.
Parameter of transferFrom; it is the amount passed to safeSub and safeAdd.
Operand parameter of safeAdd used directly by its addition.
Operand parameter of safeAdd used directly by its addition.

Operand parameter of safeSub used directly by its subtraction and require.

Operand parameter of safeMul used directly by its multiplication.
